The '''Storm I''' was a model of [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] that was used during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />
{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Storm I first appeared as a player mount in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''. It was added to the game with the release of the "Master the Fight: Storm I Edition" bundle on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="bundle">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20250429|text=The Master the Fight: Storm I Edition bundle is now available!}}</ref>
